description:
Cast Dualcaster Mage for {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Twincast, copying Double Major, targeting Dualcaster.
Let the copied Double Major resolve, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Double Major, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from Step 4.
